remarks: Wow, stunning, beautiful-let's apply! That might be your first reaction when stepping inside this luxurious townhouse, built in 2007 and still feeling brand new! With 1,710 square feet of living space, it lives like a single-family home and checks all the boxes-and then some.  You'll find 2 bedrooms, a bonus loft, ground-level recreation room, eat-in kitchen, living and dining rooms, garage, balcony, and a patio (grill included!).  The quality details shine throughout:   *  Quartz countertops and island in the kitchen   *  Gas fireplace in the living room   *  Soaring ceilings in the primary suite   *  A built-in charging station in the garage   *  Spacious walk-in storage room   *  Bonus third-floor loft   *  Sliders from the rec room to your private patio.  Need parking? You've got a garage, an extra off-street spot, and ample street parking on the quiet Willard Rd cul-de-sac.  Location? Perfect. Walk to everything: coffee shops, the movie theater, grocery stores, salons, dry cleaners, restaurants, banks-you name it.  Available August 1st-come see it in person before it's gone! Rent includes parking, water, sewer, trash and snow.
